page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8i.4xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine running on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz, providing 16 dedicated virtual CPUs. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, establishing a generous 8:1 memory-to-vCPU allocation of 8.0 GB per core.

Hardware integration excludes onboard local storage and dedicated GPU acceleration, relying on network-attached block storage for operating system and application persistent data. Network throughput is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps. The instance configuration allocates zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating VPC network routing or assigned elastic IP addresses for external connectivity.

The 8 GB per core memory profile yields qualitative cost efficiency for memory-heavy deployments by avoiding excessive vCPU provisioning simply to obtain required RAM capacity. Tradeoffs include the lack of local temporary NVMe storage and absence of hardware acceleration. Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8i.4xlarge is structured for memory-bound enterprise applications, including Redis and Memcached caching tiers, in-memory databases, real-time analytics, and transactional databases.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8i.4xlarge is a memory-optimized instance engineered for workloads demanding high memory capacity relative to compute resources. Operating under the KVM hypervisor, this virtual server is driven by a 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8475B x86_64 processor configured with 16 dedicated vCPUs and 128.0 GB of RAM, yielding an 8:1 memory-to-core allocation of 8.0 GB per virtual processor. The instance does not include integrated local disk storage or specialized GPU accelerators, requiring attached cloud storage volumes for persistent data retention. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps and allocates zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses by default. Due to its elevated memory footprint per core, ecs.r8i.4xlarge provides strong resource efficiency for memory-intensive architectures without over-provisioning compute cycles. It is suitable for in-memory databases, enterprise caching services, data processing pipelines, and high-memory transactional enterprise applications.
